question: Do frozen December2024 national spending NCut10 labels add regional held-out description of Jan2024 to Jan2025 population change beyond the full spending profile, quadratic level, initial population and same-geometry SSE10?
previous_findings_known: Salary K10 mixed and road diagnostic negative were known before proposing this separate target. No new target association examined.

scope.population: Published municipal estimated total resident population on January1, not employed workers, not migration flows. One pair of stock estimates per admitted municipality.

admission.source: feasibility_r00, exact original CSV member plus supplier workbook
admission.rule: Exact unique native upper-level code; safe history unchanged/type-name only; identical pair native/stable/interval/history; source lo<2024 hi>=2025; exact same supplier version active bothyears, unique native owner, region continuity; no Chechnya known gap; positive finite stocks/person/Jan1; no substantive comments. No name or stable-code fallback, no recovery waivers.
admission.source_hi2025_semantics: Publisher metadata line325: current code receives2025; inclusive release-end, not automatic actual cessation in2025.

feature_details.X: Exact saved national full-support December X6, no subset rebuild; population was not explicit training coordinate of this national geometry.
feature_details.T: Natural log of reported December total spending, exact reported source column Total
feature_details.F: All six X linear, all six squared, fifteen i<j products, then logPopulation0; same logPopulation0 in every design; no interaction selection from Y.

folds.rule: Sort supplier regions by descending admitted count then lexical canonical raw region code; greedily assign to smallest ID count then smallest fold index. Recompute inner assignments using outer train regions only. Never use Y/labels in fold formation.

regression.solver: Inherited exact np.linalg.svd Ridge unpenalized intercept; standardization ddof0 fit on training only; zero std->1; alpha by inner region-equal OOF MAE, largest alpha within1e-12 of minimum.
regression.missing_training_category: Retain all10 columns, scale1 coefficient0; disclose no fold change.

decision_rules.consistent: Both global region-macro deltas strictly<-1e-10, all5 outer fold deltas strictly<-1e-10, all leave-one-region deltas strictly<-1e-10.
decision_rules.D_F_interpretation: If NCut fails to improve over fixed full degree2 control, no claim of unique network information or generic nonlinear superiority. Report full fold/region/LOO results.
decision_rules.multiple_comparisons: One exploratory target, two joint primary contrasts; no p-values, no selecting successful subgroup/year, all four contrasts disclosed.

interpretation_limits: Conditional territory admission is not a physical boundary certificate. Excluded630 ID and entire missing regions constrain generalization.
Retrospective descriptive target: stock change during2024 versus December2024 spending; no prospective forecast, causal effect or separate migration claim.
Held-out Y only: spending X/scales and labels frozen on full2023-24 panel; transductive, not end-to-end holdout.
Upstream Sber use of population or Rosstat unknown; per-resident spending denominators may relate to population estimates. No independent-information guarantee.
Annualcontext6 includes population and other socioeconomic features; this does not validate context6.
Changes in population estimates may include revisions/registration effects, natural change, migration and uncaptured boundary inconsistencies.
No future demographic years or alternate transformations tried; no fit-based target trimming.
National original metric eligibility/null flags retained; valid saved partitions can be described externally despite undefined S_Dbw, not promoted to all-six-metric validity.
